note: Rewritten from Emerson's Kartabo termite monograph, original in English. The species appears there under the combination Rhinotermes nasutus Holmgren (1912), described from three alates (one collected at Issororo, two at Kartabo); the passage is followed by R. marginalis, and the large soldier of this species is not described further.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Distinguished from R. marginalis by the paler colour and larger size, and by antennal segment 3 being distinctly longer than segment 1; antennae 20-segmented, segment 3 about three times as long as segment 2. The species was originally described by Holmgren (1912) from the mandibles of the large soldier.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head orange-yellow, with several setae; circular; in front of the ocelli there are two large, conspicuous muscle attachment points. Antennae orange-yellow, 20-segmented, segment 3 very large and long, three times as long as segment 2 and distinctly longer than segment 1, enlarged apically. Compound eyes rather large, about 1/4 of an eye diameter from the lower margin of the head. Ocelli rather large, separated from the eyes by less than their own diameter. Clypeus projecting, as in other species of the subgenus. Thorax with numerous setae. Pronotum orange-yellow, almost as wide as the head; sides rounded; posterior margin slightly concave. Posterior margins of meso- and metanotum straight. Wings transparent, brownish near the base along the suture; with reticulate pattern. Legs orange-yellow. Abdomen orange-yellow, with numerous setae. Measurements: length with wings 18.91 mm, length without wings 10.00—11.00 mm; head length 2.47—2.57 mm, head width 2.28—2.35 mm; antennal length 3.85 mm; eye diameter 0.65 mm; pronotum length 1.25—1.28 mm, width 2.12—2.15 mm; hind tibia length 2.70—2.73 mm; fore-wing length 14.18 mm, width 4.02 mm.
